hypothesis_under_attack: A single fixed constant c could make canonical full-incidence-2core enumeration 2^k <= L^c admissible for every CNF.
family_definition: For n>=3 use n variables and n distinct width-2 clauses forming one incidence cycle; signs may alternate but incidence structure is unchanged.
universal_fixed_c_attack: For any fixed real c>0 let C=ceil(max(1,c)) and n=16*C^2. Then k=n and 2^k > L^C >= L^c.
proof_obligation: Verify canonical_two_core_variables returns all n variables and encoding_size returns 4n on the frozen family; independently check the inequality construction and scaling ratios.
captain_firewalls: Falsifies only universality of this fixed-c carrier family, not Trinity as a whole.
A 2SAT instance may be solved earlier by another Trinity door; that does not rescue fixed-c incidence enumeration as universal.
No SAT oracle, adaptive c selection, minimum cutset, treewidth, or backdoor search is allowed.
No P=NP conclusion is permitted from success or failure of this gate.
pass_if: A theorem-level fixed-c falsifier is verified with exact source-incidence measurements and no hidden exponential search.
fail_if: Any exact structural identity or inequality used by the falsifier is false.
